an7.52:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an7.52:1.2: athakho sambahulā campeyyakā upāsakā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavocuṃ
an7.52:1.3: cirassutā no bhante bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā
an7.52:1.4: sādhu mayaṃ bhante labheyyāma bhagavato dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
an7.52:1.6: appevanāma labheyyātha bhagavato santike dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti.
an7.52:1.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho campeyyakā upāsakā āyasmato sāriputtassa paṭissuṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
an7.52:2.1: athakho campeyyakā upāsakā tadahuposathe yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
an7.52:2.2: athakho āyasmā sāriputto tehi campeyyakehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.52:3.1: siyā nu kho bhante idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ
an7.52:3.2: siyā pana bhante idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.52:3.3: siyā sāriputta idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ
an7.52:3.4: siyā pana sāriputta idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.52:3.5: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenapi idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ na mahānisaṃsaṃ
an7.52:3.6: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenapi idhekaccassa tādisaṃyeva dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ mahānisaṃsanti.
an7.52:4.1: idha sāriputta ekacco sāpekkho dānaṃ deti paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti sannidhipekkho dānaṃ deti imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti
an7.52:4.2: so taṃ dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ
an7.52:4.3: taṃ kiṃ maññasi sāriputta dadeyya idhekacco evarūpaṃ dānanti.
an7.52:5.1: tatra sāriputta yvāyaṃ sāpekkho dānaṃ deti paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti sannidhipekkho dānaṃ deti imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti
an7.52:5.2: so taṃ dānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati
an7.52:5.3: so taṃ kammaṃ khepetvā taṃ iddhiṃ taṃ yasaṃ taṃ ādhipateyyaṃ āgāmī hoti āgantā itthattaṃ
an7.52:6.1: idha pana sāriputta ekacco naheva kho sāpekkho dānaṃ deti na paṭibaddhacitto dānaṃ deti na sannidhipekkho dānaṃ deti na imaṃ pecca paribhuñjissāmīti dānaṃ deti
an7.52:6.2: apica kho sāhu dānanti dānaṃ deti …pe…
an7.52:7.2: apica kho dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetunti dānaṃ deti
an7.52:8.1: napi dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ pitupitāmahehi na arahāmi porāṇaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ hāpetunti dānaṃ deti
an7.52:8.2: apica kho ahaṃ pacāmi ime na pacanti na arahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ adātunti dānaṃ deti
